summary: First full test after MVP build. Backend GAS emulator (/api/gas) fully verified via 9 pytest cases (100% pass) covering getAllData, addLamaran (create+persist), triggerKirim (update+persist), syncReferensi (repopulate), updateStatusTindakLanjut (write+persist), and unknown-action error paths. Frontend end-to-end mobile flow verified via Playwright on 390x844 viewport: Setup demo-button -> Home renders 5 seeded cards with correct StatusBadges (Terkirim/Proses/Gagal/Belum Dikirim) and CircularCheckboxes (checkbox disabled when Terkirim). FAB opens Add Lamaran bottom sheet; empty submit surfaces all three validation errors with correct testIDs and Indonesian copy ('tidak boleh kosong'). Filling form + tapping chip-add moves chip to selected-chips-row; Save appends a row (row_index increments) and closes sheet. Tapping the send-checkbox on the new card flips its status badge to Terkirim after refresh. Referensi tab lists 10 files and synchronize-drive works. Inbox tab shows all 5 emails with category dots; tapping opens Detail with poin-kunci highlight box + Buka di Gmail button; followup-input + followup-send persists text and it appears under the inbox card on return. Console warnings observed (React Native Web deprecation notices: shadow* props, props.pointerEvents, element.ref) - non-blocking but should be addressed.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false} instead of 400. Contract-compatible with GAS so acceptable, but non-idiomatic REST.

issues: FAB sits directly on top of the last card's send-checkbox at bottom of list; consider larger paddingBottom on FlatList when list is long

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Appears from FAB shadow in app/(tabs)/index.tsx:203-206 and similar shadows in components.

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Emitted when BottomSheetModal ref is used in src/components/AddLamaranSheet.tsx and app/(tabs)/index.tsx (sheetRef.current). Non-blocking today but will break on future @gorhom/bottom-sheet upgrade.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from @gorhom/bottom-sheet backdrop; upstream lib issue, informational.

action_items: Address React Native Web 'shadow*' deprecation: replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius blocks with boxShadow string (keep elevation for Android). Files: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (fab style).
Consider upgrading @gorhom/bottom-sheet or forwarding ref differently to silence React 19 element.ref warning (non-blocking).
Optional: return HTTP 400 for unknown POST actions on /api/gas for stricter contract; current 200 mirrors GAS behaviour so keep if intentional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well under 700 lines and clean; MongoDB _id is stripped via clean() before every response.
All frontend network calls use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (via saveUrl / DEMO_URL) - no hardcoded URLs.

All interactive elements have testID (demo-button, connect-button, fab-add, save-lamaran-button, chip-add-*, send-checkbox-*, sync-button, synchronize-drive, inbox-card-*, followup-input, followup-send, detail-back, open-gmail, detail-poin-kunci).
All text is wrapped in <Text>; no raw strings in <View>. StyleSheet.create used everywhere - no CSS classes.
Form validation on AddLamaranSheet correctly validates email format in addition to non-empty; good UX.
CircularCheckbox correctly disabled when status is Terkirim, preventing duplicate sends.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Backend auto-seeds Log_Pengiriman (5), Referensi_Berkas (10), Email_Masuk (5) via ensure_seed() on startup/first request. Tests append TEST_-prefixed rows which persist in the demo DB (test_database) - safe because it is a demo/emulator, not production data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at /api/gas is a GAS emulator with GET action=getAllData and POST actions addLamaran/triggerKirim/syncReferensi/updateStatusTindakLanjut. On the web preview each browser context starts empty AsyncStorage so ALWAYS begin at /setup and tap testID demo-button. Use mobile viewport 390x844. When testing validation on the Add Lamaran sheet, wait ~1000ms after clicking save-lamaran-button before probing is_visible on error testIDs (React re-render). ChipReorder drag-to-reorder uses long-press gesture (gesture-handler) which is unreliable on Playwright web; verify chip add/remove via testIDs chip-add-* and chip-remove-* instead. TEST_-prefixed rows persist across runs in Mongo test_database - cleanup not automated.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no failing issues. Initial run mis-reported the validation flow as FAIL because is_visible() was polled ~500ms after clicking save, before React had rendered the error <Text> nodes; a targeted retest with 1500ms wait confirmed all three error testIDs (input-email-error, input-perusahaan-error, input-posisi-error) render correctly with the expected 'tidak boleh kosong' copy.
